note: Stoneguard c7/c14/c15 engine. Emscripten 6.0.5, Release -O3 objects and -O2 link. Portable native arm64 matrix reciprocal plus fused generic OpenSubdiv stencil and patch accumulation; bodice four-stage comparison 28/28 arrays exact. Full-scene comparison and memory scope recorded in provenance/stoneguard-memory.json. Historical battery absent; no full-battery or hosted acceptance claim. Rebuilt from the public instance-source commit with the same Emscripten 6.0.5, Release -O3 objects and -O2 link. All 6287 drawable Lone Monk placements resolve to 26 native source objects and 24 deferred mesh resources. Live raster rendering still differs from native Cycles; no full-scene visual parity claim.
callTrampoline: CPython 3.13.13 is compiled with PY_CALL_TRAMPOLINE for Blender CPython slot arity casts. This applies to CPython dispatch, not arbitrary indirect calls.
engineIds: The session preserves the compiled native CYCLES engine. VOLTER_THREE selects the explicit raster presenter; BLENDER_EEVEE and BLENDER_WORKBENCH remain presentation engines.
exportDoor: The source-owned bpy_web_export.cc exports Principled physical inputs, normal images, eight named UV layers and evaluated corner normals, and takes graph_materials/graph_images/graph_generated (a graph-drawn shader mix reduced to the one Principled BSDF it reaches, graph images at the door revisions with every UDIM tile, orco for deformed meshes whose graph reads Generated coordinates). A frame can defer its changed meshes and pictures (defer) for the caller to pull one at a time (export_mesh, export_image), each call freeing the previous one's columns and a picture it decoded; an undo step keeps the revisions when Blender kept the depsgraph (session_undo); Blender's CPU subdivision descriptor is released once a mesh is read; the memory door reports malloc in-use and free. Datablock revisions are keyed by session_uid. writefile.cc writes one copy of the document per save in the browser build. CPU evaluators adopt stencil tables without cloning; browser subdivision descriptors are released immediately after CPU tessellation/deformation. Native evaluated corner triangles accompany corner normals. Consumed local conversion stencils are released before later UV channels are constructed. Caller-thread file-read, evaluated-object and subdivision checkpoints provide backpressure for resumable startup. Shared geometry revisions advance once per frame. Existing synchronous export remains available. Optional instance_sources exports stable evaluated collection and particle source meshes, including excluded library meshes and converted curves. Frame-local instance_geometry tokens verify Python placement metadata against the exported geometry and are consumed before presentation.
preloadedPayload: releasePreloadedFileData releases the JS preload buffer after session ready. The measured working payload exclusions are retained.
